intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The Palace Court has prepared a wedding with thirteen banners and nine trumpets that nobody will sound today.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: There is also a document stating that both parties agree of their own free will. Kaedra has read all of it.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “The document is excellent. I propose we apply the trumpet policy to all future events.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “They seem proud of the trumpets, though.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “The court is welcome to marry the trumpets.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A few guests laugh. The rest stare. They have spent years edging toward pillars around this princess. Nobody warned them she was funny.

intro.speaker: HERALD
intro.text: “Do you, Princess Kaedra, enter this partnership of your own free will?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I do. I remain guardian of the people I serve, and I choose {PLAYER} as my partner.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Neither my subject nor my keeper.”

intro.speaker: HERALD
intro.text: “And do you, {PLAYER}, choose Princess Kaedra of your own free will?”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I do. Including the days she comes home from saving the kingdom and wants five minutes of silence.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Ten minutes. I have negotiated the terms.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The court records the vows. Nine trumpeters go home without playing a note.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Later, in the Royal Gardens, she sits close enough for your shoulders to touch. Nobody asks her to stand guard over anything.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “There will still be frightening days. And days when I get things wrong.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Then we tell each other when we need help.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Agreed. No document required.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She rests her forehead against yours. There is nobody here to see it.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “For the record, our children will not study ceremonial speechwriting until they are old enough to refuse.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “How many children is this policy for?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I will not approve a figure before the relevant committee has met.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Who’s on the committee?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “You and I. The minutes will be brief.”
